sentences.s: When I decided to quit my full time employment it never occurred to me that I might become a part of a new international trend.

trunk.主语: it (形式主语，指代 that 从句)

components.原文: When I decided to quit my full time employment
components.中文翻译: 当我决定辞去全职工作时
components.说明: When 引导时间状语从句，修饰主句谓语 occurred。

components.原文: to quit my full time employment
components.中文翻译: 辞去我的全职工作
components.说明: 动词不定式作 decided 的宾语。

components.原文: that I might become a part of a new international trend
components.中文翻译: 我可能会成为一种新的国际潮流的一部分
components.说明: that 引导真正的主语从句，由形式主语 it 代替，置于句末。

sentences.zh: 当我决定辞去全职工作时，我从未想到自己可能会成为一种新的国际潮流的一部分。

sentences.s: A lateral move that hurt my pride and blocked my professional progress prompted me to abandon my relatively high profile career although, in the manner of a disgraced government minister, I covered my exit by claiming "I wanted to spend more time with my family".

trunk.主干翻译: 一次平级调动促使了我。

components.原文: that hurt my pride and blocked my professional progress
components.中文翻译: 它伤害了我的自尊心，并阻碍了我的职业发展
components.说明: that 引导定语从句，修饰先行词 move。

components.原文: blocked my professional progress
components.中文翻译: 阻碍了我的职业发展
components.说明: 与 hurt my pride 并列，由 and 连接，共用从句主语 that。

components.原文: to abandon my relatively high profile career
components.中文翻译: 放弃我那相对高调的职业
components.说明: 不定式作 prompted me 的宾语补足语。

components.原文: although, in the manner of a disgraced government minister, I covered my exit by claiming "I wanted to spend more time with my family"
components.中文翻译: 尽管我像一位声名扫地的政府部长那样，通过声称"我想多花些时间陪伴家人"来掩饰自己的离职
components.说明: although 引导让步状语从句；in the manner of... 为插入语作方式状语。

components.原文: I wanted to spend more time with my family
components.中文翻译: 我想多花些时间陪伴家人
components.说明: claiming 后省略 that 的宾语从句。

components.原文: to spend more time with my family
components.中文翻译: 多花些时间陪伴家人
components.说明: 不定式作 wanted 的宾语。

sentences.zh: 一次伤害了我的自尊心、阻碍了我职业发展的平级调动，促使我放弃了相对高调的职业，尽管我像一位声名扫地的政府部长那样，通过声称"我想多花些时间陪伴家人"来掩饰自己的离职。

sentences.s: Curiously, some two-and-a-half years and two novels later, my experiment in what the Americans term "downshifting"has turned my tired excuse into an absolute reality.

trunk.宾语或表语: my tired excuse into an absolute reality
trunk.主干翻译: 我的尝试已经把我那陈腐的借口变成了不折不扣的现实。

components.原文: some two-and-a-half years and two novels later
components.中文翻译: 大约两年半、两部小说之后
components.说明: two-and-a-half years 与 two novels 由 and 并列，整体作时间状语。

components.原文: in what the Americans term "downshifting"
components.中文翻译: 在美国人称之为"放慢生活节奏"方面的
components.说明: in what... 介词短语作定语修饰 experiment，what 引导宾语从句作 in 的宾语。

components.原文: Curiously
components.中文翻译: 奇怪的是
components.说明: 副词作句首插入语，表达说话人态度。

sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，大约两年半、两部小说之后，我在美国人称之为"放慢生活节奏"方面的尝试，已经把我那陈腐的借口变成了不折不扣的现实。

sentences.s: I have been transformed from a passionate advocate of the philosophy of "having it all", preached by Linda Kelsey for the past seven years in the pages of She magazine, into a woman who is happy to settle for a bit of everything.

trunk.宾语或表语: from a passionate advocate ... into a woman
trunk.主干翻译: 我已经从一个狂热的拥护者转变成了一个女人。

components.原文: of the philosophy of "having it all"
components.中文翻译: "拥有一切"这一理念的
components.说明: of 介词短语作定语，修饰 advocate。

components.原文: all
components.中文翻译: 一切
components.说明: all 与 it 同位，强调"全部"。

components.原文: preached by Linda Kelsey for the past seven years in the pages of She magazine
components.中文翻译: 在过去七年里被琳达·凯尔西在《她》杂志上所宣扬的
components.说明: 过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 philosophy。

components.原文: who is happy to settle for a bit of everything
components.中文翻译: 她乐于对每样事物都浅尝辄止、知足常乐
components.说明: who 引导定语从句，修饰先行词 woman。

components.原文: to settle for a bit of everything
components.中文翻译: 满足于每样都拥有一点
components.说明: 不定式作形容词 happy 的状语，表说明。

sentences.zh: 我已经从"拥有一切"这一理念的狂热拥护者——这一理念是琳达·凯尔西在过去七年里在《她》杂志上所宣扬的——转变成了一个乐于对每样事物都浅尝辄止、知足常乐的女人。

sentences.s: I have discovered, as perhaps Kelsey will after her much-publicized resignation from the editorship of She after a build-up of stress, that abandoning the doctrine of "juggling your life", and making the alternative move into "downshifting" brings with it far greater rewards than financial success and social status.

components.原文: as perhaps Kelsey will after her much-publicized resignation from the editorship of She after a build-up of stress
components.中文翻译: 正如凯尔西在因压力累积而备受关注地辞去《她》杂志主编一职后或许也会发现的那样
components.说明: as 引导比较状语从句，will 后省略 discover；表"正如……一样"。

components.原文: that abandoning the doctrine of "juggling your life", and making the alternative move into "downshifting" brings with it far greater rewards than financial success and social status
components.中文翻译: 放弃"忙于应付生活"的信条，转而做出"放慢生活节奏"的选择，所带来的回报远远大于经济上的成功和社会地位
components.说明: that 引导宾语从句作 discovered 的宾语；从句主语为两个动名词短语并列。

components.原文: making the alternative move into "downshifting"
components.中文翻译: 转而做出"放慢生活节奏"的选择
components.说明: 与 abandoning the doctrine... 由 and 并列，共同充当宾语从句的主语。

components.原文: than financial success and social status
components.中文翻译: 比经济上的成功和社会地位
components.说明: than 引导比较状语，与 far greater 构成比较结构。

sentences.zh: 我已经发现——也许凯尔西在因压力累积而备受关注地辞去《她》杂志主编一职后也会发现——放弃"忙于应付生活"的信条，转而选择"放慢生活节奏"，所带来的回报远远大于经济上的成功和社会地位。

sentences.s: Nothing could persuade me to return to the kind of life Kelsey used to advocate and I once enjoyed: 12-hour working days, pressured deadlines, the fearful strain of office politics and the limitations of being a parent on "quality time".

components.原文: to return to the kind of life Kelsey used to advocate and I once enjoyed: 12-hour working days, pressured deadlines, the fearful strain of office politics and the limitations of being a parent on "quality time"
components.中文翻译: 回到凯尔西曾经鼓吹、我也曾经享受过的那种生活
components.说明: 不定式短语作 persuade me 的宾语补足语。

components.原文: Kelsey used to advocate and I once enjoyed
components.中文翻译: 凯尔西曾经鼓吹、我也曾经享受过的
components.说明: 省略关系代词 that 的定语从句，修饰 the kind of life。

components.原文: to advocate
components.中文翻译: 鼓吹
components.说明: used to + 不定式，表过去习惯。

components.原文: I once enjoyed
components.中文翻译: 我也曾经享受过
components.说明: 与 Kelsey used to advocate 由 and 并列，同为定语从句。

components.原文: 12-hour working days, pressured deadlines, the fearful strain of office politics and the limitations of being a parent on "quality time"
components.中文翻译: 每天工作12小时、压力重重的截止期限、办公室政治带来的可怕紧张，以及作为家长在"优质时间"上的种种限制
components.说明: 冒号后的并列名词短语作 the kind of life 的同位语，具体说明那种生活。

components.原文: pressured deadlines, the fearful strain of office politics and the limitations of being a parent on "quality time"
components.中文翻译: 压力重重的截止期限、办公室政治带来的可怕紧张以及作为家长在"优质时间"上的限制
components.说明: 与 12-hour working days 并列，构成同位语内部的并列项。

sentences.zh: 没有什么能说服我回到凯尔西曾经鼓吹、我也曾经享受过的那种生活：每天工作12小时、压力重重的截止期限、办公室政治带来的可怕紧张，以及作为家长在"优质时间"上的种种限制。

sentences.s: In America, the move away from juggling to a simpler, less materialistic lifestyle is a well-established trend.

trunk.主干翻译: 这种转变是一种确立已久的趋势。

components.原文: In America
components.中文翻译: 在美国
components.说明: 介词短语作地点状语。

components.原文: away from juggling to a simpler, less materialistic lifestyle
components.中文翻译: 从忙于应付生活转向更简单、不那么物质化的生活方式的
components.说明: 介词短语作后置定语，修饰主语 move。

sentences.zh: 在美国，从忙于应付生活转向更简单、不那么物质化的生活方式的这种转变，已是一种确立已久的趋势。

sentences.s: Downshifting—also known in America as "voluntary simplicity"—has, ironically, even bred a new area of what might be termed anti-consumerism.

trunk.主干翻译: 放慢生活节奏甚至催生了一个新领域。

components.原文: also known in America as "voluntary simplicity"
components.中文翻译: 在美国也被称为"自愿简朴"
components.说明: 过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰主语 Downshifting，破折号插入。

components.原文: ironically
components.中文翻译: 颇具讽刺意味的是
components.说明: 副词作插入语，表说话人态度。

components.原文: of what might be termed anti-consumerism
components.中文翻译: 或许可被称为反消费主义的
components.说明: of 介词短语作定语修饰 area，what 引导宾语从句作 of 的宾语。

sentences.zh: 颇具讽刺意味的是，放慢生活节奏——在美国也被称为"自愿简朴"——甚至催生了一个或许可被称为反消费主义的新领域。

sentences.s: There are a number of best-selling downshifting self-help books for people who want to simplify their lives; there are newsletter's, such as The Tightwad Gazette, that give hundreds of thousands of Americans useful tips on anything from recycling their cling-film to making their own soap; there are even support groups for those who want to achieve the mid- '90s equivalent of dropping out.

trunk.主语: There (a number of books / newsletters / support groups)
trunk.主干翻译: 有一些书；有一些时事通讯；甚至还有一些互助小组。

components.原文: There are a number of best-selling downshifting self-help books for people who want to simplify their lives
components.中文翻译: 有许多畅销的、面向想简化生活之人的放慢节奏类自助书籍
components.说明: 三个 there be 分句以分号并列，此为第一个分句。

components.原文: who want to simplify their lives
components.中文翻译: 他们想简化自己的生活
components.说明: who 引导定语从句，修饰 people。

components.原文: to simplify their lives
components.中文翻译: 简化他们的生活
components.说明: 不定式作 want 的宾语。

components.原文: there are newsletter's, such as The Tightwad Gazette, that give hundreds of thousands of Americans useful tips on anything from recycling their cling-film to making their own soap
components.中文翻译: 有一些时事通讯，如《吝啬鬼公报》，它们就从回收保鲜膜到自制肥皂等各种事情向数十万美国人提供实用建议
components.说明: 第二个并列分句。

components.原文: such as The Tightwad Gazette
components.中文翻译: 比如《吝啬鬼公报》
components.说明: such as 引导举例，作插入语补充说明 newsletters。

components.原文: that give hundreds of thousands of Americans useful tips on anything from recycling their cling-film to making their own soap
components.中文翻译: 它们就从回收保鲜膜到自制肥皂等各种事情向数十万美国人提供实用建议
components.说明: that 引导定语从句，修饰 newsletters。

components.原文: there are even support groups for those who want to achieve the mid- '90s equivalent of dropping out
components.中文翻译: 甚至还有面向那些想实现90年代中期版"退出主流"之人的互助小组
components.说明: 第三个并列分句。

components.原文: who want to achieve the mid- '90s equivalent of dropping out
components.中文翻译: 他们想实现90年代中期版的"退出主流"
components.说明: who 引导定语从句，修饰 those。

components.原文: to achieve the mid- '90s equivalent of dropping out
components.中文翻译: 实现90年代中期版的"退出主流"
components.说明: 不定式作 want 的宾语。

sentences.zh: 有许多畅销的、面向想简化生活之人的放慢节奏类自助书籍；有一些时事通讯，如《吝啬鬼公报》，它们就从回收保鲜膜到自制肥皂等各种事情向数十万美国人提供实用建议；甚至还有面向那些想实现90年代中期版"退出主流"之人的互助小组。

sentences.s: While in America the trend started as a reaction to the economic decline—after the mass redundancies caused by downsizing in the late '80s—and is still linked to the politics of thrift, in Britain, at least among the middle-class downshifters of my acquaintance, we have different reasons for seeking to simplify our lives.

components.原文: While in America the trend started as a reaction to the economic decline—after the mass redundancies caused by downsizing in the late '80s—and is still linked to the politics of thrift
components.中文翻译: 虽然在美国这一趋势始于对经济衰退的反应——出现在80年代末因精简机构而导致大规模裁员之后——且至今仍与节俭政治相关联
components.说明: While 引导让步状语从句，与主句构成对比。

components.原文: caused by downsizing in the late '80s
components.中文翻译: 由80年代末的精简机构所导致的
components.说明: 过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 redundancies。

components.原文: is still linked to the politics of thrift
components.中文翻译: 至今仍与节俭政治相关联
components.说明: 与 started as... 由 and 并列，共用从句主语 the trend。

components.原文: at least among the middle-class downshifters of my acquaintance
components.中文翻译: 至少在我所认识的中产阶级放慢节奏者中
components.说明: 介词短语作范围状语，插入在主句中。

components.原文: for seeking to simplify our lives
components.中文翻译: 想要简化生活的
components.说明: for + 动名词短语作定语，修饰 reasons；其中 to simplify 为 seeking 的宾语。

sentences.zh: 虽然在美国，这一趋势始于对经济衰退的反应——出现在80年代末因精简机构而导致大规模裁员之后——且至今仍与节俭政治相关联，但在英国，至少在我所认识的中产阶级放慢节奏者中，我们想要简化生活的理由却与此不同。

sentences.s: For the women of my generation who were urged to keep juggling through the '80s, downshifting in the mid-'90s is not so much a search for the mythical good life—growing your own organic vegetables, and risking turning into one—as a personal recognition of your limitations.

trunk.宾语或表语: a search for the mythical good life ... a personal recognition of your limitations
trunk.主干翻译: 在90年代中期放慢生活节奏，与其说是寻求那种神话般的美好生活，不如说是对自身局限的一种个人化的认识。

components.原文: who were urged to keep juggling through the '80s
components.中文翻译: 她们在整个80年代被敦促着不停地连轴转、应付种种事务
components.说明: who引导定语从句，修饰先行词women，作主语。

components.原文: to keep juggling through the '80s
components.中文翻译: 不停地连轴转、忙碌应付（直到整个80年代）
components.说明: 动词不定式作urge的宾语补足语（urge sb to do）。

components.原文: juggling
components.中文翻译: 不停地忙于应付多项事务
components.说明: 现在分词作keep的宾语补足语（keep doing）。

components.原文: growing your own organic vegetables, and risking turning into one
components.中文翻译: 自己种植有机蔬菜，甚至冒着自己也变成有机蔬菜（般田园之人）的风险
components.说明: 破折号引出对the mythical good life的同位说明。

components.原文: risking turning into one
components.中文翻译: 冒着变成那样一种（人/物）的风险
components.说明: 由and连接的并列动名词短语，与growing并列。

components.原文: turning into one
components.中文翻译: 变成那样一种东西
components.说明: 动名词短语作risk的宾语。

sentences.zh: 对于我这一代在整个80年代被敦促着不停连轴转的女性而言，90年代中期放慢生活节奏，与其说是去追寻那种神话般的美好生活——自己种有机蔬菜，甚至冒着把自己也变成一棵“蔬菜”的风险——不如说是对自身能力局限的一种个人化认识。
